pages.text: Surround an Ender Pearl with Nether Quartz to make an Ariente Pearl. Bring more than the entrance needs: locator throws can be lost.

pages.title: Find an entrance
pages.text: Use a Pearl in the air in the Overworld. It flies toward a nearby intact underground entrance.$(br2)New entrances prefer dry caves, sometimes joined by a short tunnel. Their depth varies; some remain buried when no suitable cave is nearby.$(br2)Follow the Pearl and search underground. If none is found, try another area. A thrown Pearl may drop for recovery; watch where it lands.

pages.title: Charge and travel
pages.text: Right-click the Warper with Pearls. The usual requirement is $(thing)10 charges$(). Open its hologram and press Warp when ready.$(br2)Warper charge is separate from flux power. Cable generators do not charge it. Once charged, ordinary trips do not spend that charge.

pages.title: Plan your return
pages.text: The arrival building has a charged return Warper. Record its location and keep a safe path back.$(br2)The return trip tries your remembered entrance first. If that landing is unusable, it falls back to a safe respawn location or world spawn.$(br2)Avoid breaking either Warper while you rely on the route.
